newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - July 2.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - July 2.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the Japanese press on Wednesday, as reported by Kyodo news agency.
-- Fuji Bank Ltd, Yasuda Mutual Life Insurance Co and Yasuda Trust & Banking Co Ltd, to strengthen ties in capital and business areas.
- NEC Corp, Mitsui & Co Ltd and Sumitomo Corp and Russian regional telephone firm to launch digitalised telephone operating system in Russia.
-- About 70 percent of Japanese people cautious about food aid to North Korea.
-- "Focus" magazine carries photo of 14-year-old Kobe murder suspect, but sales halted at many kiosks and other stores.
-- Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank Ltd found to have loaned hundreds of millions of yen to another big corporate racketeer group.
-- Support rate for Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto cabinet rises nine percent points to 43 percent.
